comments.author: frank
comments.body: reason_code only has ~20 valid values and amount must be positive. If Dispute were a Pydantic model you'd get that validation for free instead of trusting the caller.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: I went with a dataclass because of ADR-005, but I don't have a strong opinion. Alice?

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Dataclass is right. Per ADR-005 validation happens once at the edge; here the edge is the notification consumer, which already validates reason codes against the network's enum. We decided this in #109, not reopening it per PR.

threads.rejection_reason: ADR-005: domain types are dataclasses; validation happens at the edge.
